claim_summary: For every d>=2, the known universal 1-to-2 qudit cloner yields a selfcompatible depolarizing channel with an exact optimal EB Dirichlet constant 2.

The cloner's normalized Choi state has exact minimum EB trace distance (d-1)/(2d), attained by the depolarizing EB threshold channel; this is a channel-level entangled-input certificate, not a fixed-sandwich lower bound.

A nonselfadjoint bistochastic cyclic-shift instrument produces a positive selfadjoint selfcompatible corrected marginal with an exact factor-2 SOS; its canonical depolarizing EB map satisfies the sharper sharp-for-that-map factor 4/3.
status: initial checkpoint saved; exact benchmark and instrument fixture proved; unrestricted fixed-sandwich broadcasting-to-EB problem remains open
